instruction: Within the Reminders app, find and remove the reminder that has the title "Test reminder delete".
reference_command:
reminder_id=$(remindctl all --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.title == "Test reminder delete") | .id' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$reminder_id" ]; then
  echo "Reminder not found: Test reminder delete"
  exit 1
fi
remindctl delete "$reminder_id" --force
